params.body:
## Headings
Every section title was italic Newsreader with its second word in the dot face, on every page, until it read as a tic.
- `.section-title` is now upright Newsreader. A `.dots` or `.display-accent` word inside a heading (`h1`, `h2`, `.section-title`) is set in Newsreader italic.
- This is one CSS change, so every page title and section title follows.
- The dot face stays where it carries weight: "Youth culture." in the hero, the numbers band, prices, momentum and step numbers.

## /reports
- The collage header sat directly above the featured report's cover: two busy images on top of each other, plus a second "Create a free account" next to the one in the nav. It is now a quiet header on paper.
- "A new report every month" is said once on the page: the section says it, the header no longer does.
- The section's intro no longer repeats the header's "one cultural shift at a time".
- Elsewhere, the home link is "All reports" again, and the reader's end page drops the line.

## Copy
- **How we read:** one-word titles (Signal, Pattern, Direction, Implication) with plain sentences. "a flash from a filament" is gone, and "That is the quality claim" becomes "Nothing is published that skipped a step."
- **Newsletter:** "The signals before they break. No fluff." and "No noise." become "What moved this week, read by the Trendwolves editorial team. One email, every week."
- **Contact:**
  - "Pro access" (a plan that no longer exists) becomes "a plan".
  - The topic "Starting a free trial" becomes "Early access to a paid plan", since there is no trial.
- **Services:**
  - "Intelligence that scales with you" and "the speed of culture" become "From the archive to your own team", with one sentence on the choices.
  - The heading "Built for people who need to get it right" no longer repeats the home page; it is "Who it is for".
  - Removed: "third activation level", "a brand asset no competitor can copy" and "Trusted by brands who cannot afford to misread". "Bridge" appeared twice.
  - The Trendwolves section no longer says workshops and keynotes are part of Intelligence.
  - "Landing pages launching soon" appeared twice and is now said once.
- **Register:** "Create a free account to read premium posts" was not true, because a free account does not open premium posts. It now reads "Read the latest posts and the trends, and get the weekly letter."
- **Trends:** "right now" appeared twice in a row.
- **Connect:** one broken sentence fixed.

## Figures with a source
The services figures were "20+ years research", "8 sectors covered" (the list below names 12) and "32 client profiles" (no source found). They are now:

| Figure | Source |
|---|---|
| 20 years of research | trendwolves.com |
| 100+ keynotes and workshops a year | trendwolves.com |
| 12 sectors read | the Gentells Standard |

Tests: 344 passing. Checked locally: home, services, pricing, reports, contact, connect, trends, register.
params.title: Copy across the site, headings without the dot font, sourced figures, a calm reports header
